name: Wise Man
overview: Scripture presents the wise man as one who values learning and wise counsel, growing in understanding through hearing and hearkening to instruction, as seen in Proverbs 1:5 and 12:15. True wisdom begins with the fear of the LORD, which is foundational to knowledge, contrasting sharply with the folly of despising wisdom (Proverbs 1:7). The wise man is prudent and self-controlled, preserving valuable resources and restraining his words, unlike the fool who squanders and speaks impulsively (Proverbs 21:20; 29:11). This biblical portrait highlights wisdom as both a reverence for God and a practical lifestyle marked by discernment and restraint.
